description: This PHP source file defines the SimpleSqlSearchEngine class, a naive search engine implementation for SuiteCRM that performs database searches using LIKE queries on table structures. It includes methods for searching modules, filtering table fields, and constructing SQL queries.

classes.name: SimpleSqlSearchEngine
classes.description: A naive search engine class that performs LIKE-based searches on database tables within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search across modules and returns SearchResults with timing information.

methods.name: filterTableStructure
methods.description: Filters table fields to include only varchar and text types relevant for searching.

methods.name: getTableStructure
methods.description: Retrieves the structure of a database table as a name->type array.

methods.name: validateQuery
methods.description: Validates and processes the SearchQuery object, including encoding conversion.

methods.name: searchModule
methods.description: Performs a search within a specific module's table and returns matching record IDs.

methods.name: makeSearchQuery
methods.description: Constructs the SQL query string for searching a table with given fields and search string.
